title: SKE Bar Fresh Menthol Mojito Prefilled Vape Pod
description: Designed for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit, this Fresh Menthol Mojito pod offers a bright, minty vape inspired by the classic cocktail. You'll taste cooling Menthol and fresh Mint leaves, layered with a subtle splash of Lime for a sharp, herbal citrus finish. Each 2ml pod includes 20mg nicotine salt and uses mesh coil tech for a smooth, consistent MTL experience. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
